scope: Bounded primary-source review; not a historical-priority certificate.

sources.title: Fast and Robust Fixed-Point Algorithms for Independent Component Analysis
sources.author: Aapo Hyvarinen
sources.read_scope: Original algorithm and ICA-model framing; also reviewed in the earlier empirical FastICA packet.
sources.implication: Algorithm is established; constructed inputs do not establish a new algorithm.

sources.title: A study of the fixed points and spurious solutions of the FastICA algorithm
sources.author: Tianwen Wei
sources.read_scope: Abstract and Section 2.1; earlier packet covers fixed-point and sampling discussion.
sources.implication: Independence of latent sources is an explicit model hypothesis; not asserted for our construction.

sources.title: Shifted Power Method for Computing Tensor Eigenpairs
sources.read_scope: Introduction, gradient identity and Section 3.2, especially Example 3.5.
sources.implication: Unshifted symmetric tensor power nonconvergence is established. The 2002 example is reproduced, with 3-dimensional tensor coefficients distinct from our 4-dimensional construction; this dimension observation does not rule out dynamical equivalence.

sources.title: On the Best Rank-1 Approximation of Higher-Order Supersymmetric Tensors
sources.read_scope: Publisher abstract only. Its numerical counterexample was read as reproduced by Kolda and Mayo.
sources.implication: Convergence assumptions and known nonconvergence must be credited.

outcome: No exact 720-row realization with this trapping interval was located in the returned material. Known tensor power iteration and circle expansion prevent a new-mechanism claim.
open_questions: Priority of the explicit finite-data realization
Equivalence of the positive-epsilon attracting set to known circle extensions
Transitivity and equality with sampled orbit closure
Uniform hyperbolicity and injectivity; no Smale-Williams classification established
visual_assessment: Nested narrow strands at epsilon=0.04; broader bands at 0.15. Visually distinct topology is not established.
